deltas.description: Added recommended fuzz command doc comment with -max_len=65536 -runs=100000
Added recommended fuzz command doc comment with -max_len=65536 -runs=100000
Aligned fuzz payload bound with production YamlLimits::max_nodes

soundness.enforcement_chain: parse_yaml_events calls validate_yaml_profile which calls collect_and_validate_events which enforces max_nodes via record_node for every event. If events exceed 100000, validation returns NodeLimitExceeded and parse_yaml_events returns Err. When parse_yaml_events returns Ok(events), events.len() is guaranteed <= 100000.
soundness.old_bound_issue: 4096 was too small; valid YAML with up to 100000 events would pass production validation but fail fuzz assertion (false positive).
soundness.source_map_bound: build_source_map validates first then collects. Source map entries are a subset of events (only MappingStart/SequenceStart/Scalar produce entries). source_map.len() <= events.len() <= 100000.

notes: The bound change is behavioral, not documentation-only. It corrects the fuzz target to match production enforcement. The doc comments are useful for users.
